goal: Create a complete Primer-mapped course outline for human review

in_scope: Full course outline, pinned Primer inventory and source-to-lesson matrix; learning guide and prerequisites; module problems, outcomes, lesson outlines, integrated exercises, reference solution and self-evaluation criteria, decision summaries and cross-module capstone as planned components.
Independent coverage and pedagogical review and structural validation.
out_of_scope: Actual lessons, assessments, and learner publication.
Jira-style delivery planning and task breakdown until explicit user confirmation of the outline.
Workflow changes and resumption of historical held tasks.

constraints: Audience: middle/senior engineers; learner-facing language English, per repository defaults.
Use System Design Primer revision ae9bbd7b02d90b9866215de185217d33f39ab733 as pinned topic map; inventory every knowledge topic including solution and OOD bodies and optional topics.
Keep draft; independent review and explicit human confirmation required; no merge or publication.
Retain prior feedback, including the overlapping search lesson scope and stale reference findings, without resuming the historical held task.

definition_of_done.text: Produce complete lesson-level outline, inventory and matrix representing the requested course structure.
Independent reviewer checks full pinned-source enumeration and plan pedagogy; findings resolved within permitted revision cycles.
Run strict course review gate and required repository validation; document results and hand off for human confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every Primer knowledge topic maps to a concrete lesson outline; resource classifications have reasons; course and module components match the user structure.
Artifact-bound coverage and pedagogy verdict passes with no material unresolved findings.
Strict course check passes; user approval remains separate from automation.
